name: Silent Wake
description: Naval cyber-kinetic exercise domain — systems, weapons, warfare domains, and blue card catalog for Silent Wake scenarios.

blue_card_catalog.title: Continue Mission
blue_card_catalog.description: Maintain current course, speed, and posture. No change to systems or readiness.

blue_card_catalog.title: Reduce Speed / Safer Nav
blue_card_catalog.description: Slow to minimum safe speed. Increases reaction time but extends transit.

blue_card_catalog.title: Internal Sync (60 seconds)
blue_card_catalog.description: Pause for 60-second crew coordination. All departments share current picture.

blue_card_catalog.title: Increase Speed
blue_card_catalog.description: Increase to maximum safe speed to close distance or clear an area faster.

blue_card_catalog.title: Increase Lookouts / Visual Confirm
blue_card_catalog.description: Post additional bridge lookouts. Visually confirm contacts that appear on sensors or AIS.

blue_card_catalog.title: Start Investigation
blue_card_catalog.description: Begin first-level investigation of a suspect system or anomaly. ~5 min ETBOL.

blue_card_catalog.title: Start In-Depth Investigation
blue_card_catalog.description: Deep-dive analysis of a previously investigated component. Requires SWB07 played first.

blue_card_catalog.title: AIS Tracks Re-evaluation
blue_card_catalog.description: Cross-reference all AIS contacts against radar and ESM. Identify spoofed or phantom tracks.

blue_card_catalog.title: Isolate System
blue_card_catalog.description: Disconnect a suspect system from the network to contain potential compromise.

blue_card_catalog.title: Reboot Affected System
blue_card_catalog.description: Power-cycle a degraded system to restore normal operation. Brief capability gap during restart.

blue_card_catalog.title: Repair Component
blue_card_catalog.description: Dispatch repair team to fix a faulty hardware component. Time depends on severity.

blue_card_catalog.title: Reconnect System
blue_card_catalog.description: Bring an isolated system back online after investigation or repair.

blue_card_catalog.title: Damage Control Focus
blue_card_catalog.description: Prioritise damage control teams on critical systems. Reduces repair time for ongoing fixes.

blue_card_catalog.title: Correct Course
blue_card_catalog.description: Adjust heading to compensate for navigation drift or unsafe track.

blue_card_catalog.title: General Quarters
blue_card_catalog.description: Set Condition 1. All hands to battle stations. Powers on all combat systems.

blue_card_catalog.title: Prepare Target
blue_card_catalog.description: Begin target tracking and fire-control solution. Required before weapons engagement.

blue_card_catalog.title: Close Range to Compensate
blue_card_catalog.description: Reduce range to hostile to improve degraded sensor or weapon effectiveness.

blue_card_catalog.title: Approach Target
blue_card_catalog.description: Close with a contact for visual identification or engagement positioning.

blue_card_catalog.title: Shift to Gun Focus
blue_card_catalog.description: Transition primary engagement to naval gun. Backup when missile systems are degraded.

blue_card_catalog.title: Fire Missile Counterattack
blue_card_catalog.description: Launch anti-ship missile at designated hostile target. Requires fire-control solution.

blue_card_catalog.title: Engage Target with Guns
blue_card_catalog.description: Open fire with naval gun on hostile surface contact at effective range.

blue_card_catalog.title: Decoy Deployment
blue_card_catalog.description: Deploy chaff and/or IR decoys to defeat incoming missile threat.

blue_card_catalog.title: Approach Land (Emergency Concealment)
blue_card_catalog.description: Move close to shore to use land clutter as radar concealment. Last resort.
